Cannonball Atari Falcon 030 / CT60 / CT63 port - v0.32 beta (compiled release)
See VERSION.txt at the root of the repository for the changelog.

CB030.TOS - original Falcon 030 (68030 @ 16 MHz): runs, but too slow to be really playable
CB060.TOS - Falcon + CT60 / CT63 (68060): full speed
outrun.ini - mod=1, mod_dsp=1 (.mod music played by the DSP; set mod_dsp=0 for CPU mixing,
             mod=0 for the original FM music, computed by the DSP with fm_dsp=1)
PADTEST.TOS - joystick test: shows live what each joystick socket returns
ROMNAME.TOS - renames the ROMs to short 8.3 names (S, plain TOS) or long names (L, FreeMiNT)
